title: Stokes' theorem on positively graded groups
summary: This paper studies the validity of Stokes' theorem for differential subcomplexes naturally adapted to the noncommutative geometry of positively graded Lie groups, with particular emphasis on Carnot groups. We introduce geometric conditions under which Stokes-type formulae hold for the Rumin complex and for a new family of spectral complexes associated with the homogeneous weight filtration of the de Rham complex.
